Tara L: Heads-up — I'm looking into how SLO rule transforms interact with per-tenant quota/spillover when rules are edited in the console. The current behavior seems to duplicate alerts and double-count quota. Anyone seen this?
Mike H: I can repro. If transform adds an extra notify channel we fanout twice. Likely during the normalize step we duplicate 'notify' array. :facepalm: 
Samir: Is this the same bug we fixed last month for route affinity? Or different? I thought that was fanout dedupe in the router.
Mike H: Different. That was run-time dedupe; this is during the transform pipeline in the console API that expands shorthand rules into full notify entries.
Anya: Quick note — telemetry shows a spike in notify_count per-rule after edits, timestamped to edits from the UI, matches Mike's repro.
Priya: Can you paste the API payload that's causing it?
Mike H: Sure: 
```json
{"ruleId":"r-123","shorthand":"email+pager","transformRules":[{"expand":"notify","to":["email","pagerduty"]}],"quotaBucket":"customer-A"}
```
Samir: Looks fine at first glance. The issue is the normalize step applies transforms both on client and server when console autosave is enabled. So server sees expanded entries twice.
Tara L: Ugh. So double application only when autosave + rollback edits happen?
Mike H: Exactly. The client sends expanded, server expands again. We need an idempotent transform marker.
Anya: Telemetry idea — tag transformed entries with meta.transform_version and emit metric alerting on transform_count per-rule. That will help detect regressions.
Priya: For quota accounting, we should count distinct notify channel fingerprints, not array length. We can hash (route_id,channel) and dedupe in quota pipeline.
Samir: Agree. That also helps with noisy alerts. If the same channel would be charged twice we normalize.
Tara L: UX question: should the console show that a transform happened? Users editing rule might be surprised to see extra channels.
Anya: Maybe show a subtle "expanded by policy" pill in the rule preview with a tooltip. Keeps UI simple but transparent.
Mike H: On API side, propose adding "transform_detected": true with "transform_version" so the server can ignore if already applied. Backwards compat required.
Priya: Migration path: v2/notify_rules endpoint that accepts a 'transforms_applied' boolean. Old clients map to false. Gradual rollout by feature flag.
Tara L: Can we do a canary behind flag for 10% tenants first? Need to monitor quota metrics and notify noise.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for feature flag slo-transform-idempotent -> 10% of tenants. (deployment id: df-788)
Mike H: I'll add unit tests for client+server idempotency and an e2e that simulates autosave + quick edit.
Samir: Also add an alert: if notify_count spikes > 3x baseline within 5m for a tenant, auto-snooze transform expansion and open an incident.
Anya: Add route_id tag to telemetry and a 'transform_count' histogram. I'll add dashboard panels.
Tara L: Awesome. Owners? Mike on API, Anya on telemetry/dashboard, Priya on quota pipeline, Samir on router/fanout dedupe, I'll handle console UI tips. Let's sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
